summary: Ferrari N.V. disclosed its periodic buyback report via Form 6-K, its US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report, detailing repurchases under a EUR 250 million third tranche of a roughly EUR 3.5 billion multi-year program running to 2030. Between September 28 and October 2, 2026, Ferrari bought 73,534 common shares for EUR 25.6 million at an average EUR 348.65 per share, split between Euronext Milan and NYSE. Cumulative third-tranche spend reached EUR 102.2 million; treasury holds 1.06% of common shares, or 0.80% of total capital. Watch execution pace versus the authorization and any earnings-accretive effect.
